expectations.text: Uses POST https://api.x.ai/v1/custom-voices with multipart file upload
expectations.evidence: The example posts to /v1/custom-voices with files={"file": (...)}.

expectations.text: Extracts voice_id from the custom voice creation response
Uses the custom voice_id in a subsequent POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts request
expectations.evidence: The speech request posts to /v1/tts with json containing "voice_id": voice_id.
The output writes speech.content with open("custom.mp3", "wb").

expectations.text: Clearly warns that custom voice creation is opt-in and not part of automated smoke tests
expectations.evidence: The answer opens with an opt-in warning and says custom voice creation is not part of automated smoke tests.

workarounds: Manual artifact because no independent subagent runner is exposed in this environment.
